home.metaTitle: LifeTalea — Family stories and voice memories
home.metaDescription: A private place for photographs, voices and family stories. Explore the LifeTalea development preview.

features.title: A home for the stories behind your photographs
features.summary: Explore the LifeTalea development preview: written memories, private photographs, voice stories, albums and keepsakes.

sections.title: Start with one moment
sections.body: Write a title and a few lines. Add an exact date, an approximate year or no date at all. Tags, favourites and albums help you find the story again.

sections.title: Photographs and voices, together
sections.body: Import photographs using your device’s document picker. Record a voice story and keep it beside the written memory. Media is copied into private app storage.

sections.title: Make a collection your own
sections.body: Create scrapbook drafts from saved memories. Arrange pages, add captions and preview your collection. PDF export is a Premium feature; purchasing still needs Amazon test verification.

family-memory-journal.title: Preserve the details only your family knows
family-memory-journal.summary: A family memory journal gives context to photographs: who was there, what happened, and why the moment mattered.

sections.title: Ask a small question
sections.body: Instead of starting with a whole life story, ask about one meal, one journey or one place. A short answer is a valuable beginning. Let the storyteller choose what feels comfortable.

sections.title: Keep uncertainty honest
sections.body: Old photographs rarely come with perfect dates. LifeTalea accepts a year, month, exact date or unknown date. You can add a location yourself without granting location access.

sections.title: Preserve a second copy
sections.body: Local storage keeps memories close, but a device can be lost. Export a backup and keep it in a location you control. Check the archive before deleting an original.

voice-story-recording.title: Make room for their voice
voice-story-recording.summary: Capture the pauses, laughter and familiar expressions that a written story cannot always hold.

sections.title: Record with care
sections.body: Ask the speaker’s permission. Find a quiet space and make a short test recording. Save a memory first, then choose Record a story. Pause or resume whenever you need.

sections.title: On your device
sections.body: LifeTalea saves AAC audio in M4A files in private app storage. Leaving the app stops and saves the recording. Free recordings are limited to three minutes; Premium extends that limit, subject to storage.

sections.title: Check your tablet
sections.body: Recording requires a working microphone and permission. Speech commands use an installed recognition service and may not be available on Fire tablets. Touch controls remain available.

voice-transcription.title: A written companion to a spoken memory
voice-transcription.summary: Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.

sections.title: What works today
sections.body: Open a memory and edit its transcript field. You can type a transcript or paste text you already have. Corrections are stored locally beside the original recording.

sections.title: Review transcript draft
sections.body: Transcribe recordings up to ten minutes long. Longer recordings are safe and can have a manually entered transcript.

sections.title: Separate services
sections.body: Android speech recognition for commands is different from transcribing a saved recording. A device having one capability does not establish support for the other.

digital-scrapbook.title: Turn a collection into a chapter
digital-scrapbook.summary: Bring written memories and photographs into saved scrapbook drafts.

sections.title: Choose the moments
sections.body: Create a scrapbook and choose memories from your library. Each page refers to a saved memory, keeping its story and photographs together.

sections.title: Find the right rhythm
sections.body: Move pages up or down, select a story or photograph layout, and add a caption. Save your captions before previewing. A deleted source memory is clearly marked so you can repair the draft.

sections.title: Keep it private
sections.body: Scrapbook drafts are local. Creating a scrapbook never publishes it. Review any exported document before you decide to share it.

family-timeline.title: Remember how the chapters connect
family-timeline.summary: Explore saved memories in date order, including those with approximate and unknown dates.

sections.title: Follow the years
sections.body: The timeline sorts known dates from newest to oldest and places undated stories afterwards. Search for a phrase, select an album or filter by year.

sections.title: A date can change
sections.body: Family research often reveals a new detail. Edit the event date and precision in the memory editor; the timeline uses the updated information.

sections.title: No invented history
sections.body: The timeline uses only stories you save. LifeTalea does not populate your library with fabricated family events.

keepsake-books.title: A keepsake to hold onto
keepsake-books.summary: Create a local PDF from a scrapbook’s selected memories, photographs and captions.

sections.title: Choose what to include
sections.body: Give the book a cover title. Select A4 or Letter paper. Locations and transcripts are excluded by default and can be included when appropriate.

sections.title: Review before sharing
sections.body: PDFs are generated on the device through Android’s PDF API. Long stories continue onto extra pages. Audio is not embedded in printed keepsakes. Review typography and photographs in your PDF viewer before printing.

sections.title: Development status
sections.body: PDF generation is implemented and under device validation. The Premium export control requires a verified Amazon entitlement. Live billing is not yet verified.

offline-memory-journal.title: Your memories, even without a connection
offline-memory-journal.summary: LifeTalea is designed around local storage and touch controls, without a mandatory account.

sections.title: Keep creating offline
sections.body: Written memories, albums, imported photographs, saved recordings, timeline browsing and scrapbook drafts use local data. PDF generation does not require an external document service.

sections.title: Know the boundaries
sections.body: Push to talk uses your device’s speech service, which may need internet and process speech externally. Only continue if you agree. Audio commands are not saved by LifeTalea. Command phrases currently support English. Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.

sections.title: Backups are your choice
sections.body: Use the document picker to save an archive where you choose. If you select a cloud-backed document provider, that provider handles the exported file under its own privacy terms.

fire-tablet-compatibility.title: Built with Fire tablets in mind
fire-tablet-compatibility.summary: A native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose application with no required Google Play Services.

sections.title: Target platform
sections.body: The minimum supported Android API is 26. This is a technical minimum, not a promise that every device is certified. Fire TV remote navigation is outside the current scope.

sections.title: Device testing
sections.body: A connected KFTRWI device reporting Android API 28 is available for development testing. The release report records actual tests; additional Fire sizes and operating-system versions remain to be checked.

sections.title: Voice varies by device
sections.body: A microphone supports recording only when permission and hardware are available. Recognition and spoken feedback also need compatible installed services. Touch and text alternatives are always part of the design.

languages.title: A journal that can feel like home
languages.summary: The development app has a 22-locale translation matrix covering 17 priority languages. Native-language review is still required.

sections.title: The language plan
sections.body: Targets include regional English, Spanish, French and Portuguese, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Japanese, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, Indonesian, Korean and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

sections.title: Quality before a language claim
sections.body: Translations must pass placeholder checks, layout tests and review. Store languages, app languages, distribution countries, speech recognition, spoken feedback and transcription each have separate support matrices.

sections.title: Your words stay yours
sections.body: Changing the interface language does not translate personal memories or recordings. Unreviewed website translations are available in local preview only; production requires review.

pricing.title: Keep the memories. Choose the extras.
pricing.summary: A free journal with an optional one-time Premium purchase. Purchasing is not live in this development preview.

sections.title: Free
sections.body: Up to three albums, written memories, photographs, a timeline, scrapbook drafts and voice recordings up to three minutes. Saved written memories are not capped.

sections.title: LifeTalea Premium
sections.body: Planned one-time entitlement: unlimited albums, longer voice recordings, PDF keepsake exports and encrypted local backup. The proposed UK test price is £4.99; the app will show the actual local price from Amazon when configured.

sections.title: Your existing stories remain accessible
sections.body: Premium availability does not lock you out of existing memories. Basic backup and restore remain available. Cloud transcription with ongoing costs is not included in a one-time price promise.

faq.title: A few things worth knowing
faq.summary: Practical answers about privacy, recordings, family stories and local preservation.

sections.title: Do I need an account?
sections.body: Core local features require no LifeTalea account. Amazon purchasing uses the account and services provided by the Amazon Appstore.

sections.title: How do I organise old photographs?
sections.body: Begin with a small album and one photograph. Add names and context you know, use approximate dates when needed, and ask a relative about one detail at a time.

sections.title: Can I record my parents’ life stories?
sections.body: Yes, with their permission and a compatible microphone. Start with a brief topic and check playback. Do not rely on a single device as your only copy.

sections.title: Can I transcribe recordings?
sections.body: Create a draft from this recording on your device. No audio is uploaded. Choose the spoken language, then confirm. Recordings up to ten minutes are supported. Processing may be slow; check the draft for mistakes before saving.

sections.title: Does LifeTalea sync between devices?
sections.body: No cloud sync is implemented. Local archive export and restore are the preservation tools currently provided.

privacy.title: Privacy starts with where a story lives
privacy.summary: Development privacy notice from O.Bankole. Contact banksmi@mail.com. Legal review remains required before public release.

sections.title: Memories and media
sections.body: Stories, transcripts, photographs, audio and scrapbook drafts stay in private app storage by default. LifeTalea does not require an account, collect location automatically or include advertising and analytics SDKs. Android automatic backup is disabled.

sections.title: Choices that involve other services
sections.body:
Speech recognition uses your installed speech service, which may process speech over a network. It is activated only through push-to-talk with a disclosure. Amazon purchasing communicates with Amazon. Exporting to a cloud document provider shares the selected archive with that provider.

Amazon purchases send app-specific Amazon user and receipt identifiers to LifeTalea’s Supabase-hosted verifier and Amazon. Providers may retain request and connection logs. Stories, photos and recordings are not sent for verification. Saved-recording transcription runs on this device. Exported files must be deleted separately.

Optional daily reminder around 20:00 local time. Delivery may be delayed by device settings. Notifications contain no story content. Off by default.

sections.title: Deletion and retention
sections.body: You can delete individual memories and attachments or all local library data in Settings. Uninstalling removes local app data. Exported files are separate copies that you manage yourself. Purchase records are retained by Amazon under its policies.

sections.title: Security limits
sections.body: Private app storage relies on device protections; the local database does not have a separate application encryption key. Optional encrypted archives use a passphrase. There is no claim of end-to-end encryption or a completed legal compliance assessment.

support.title: A little help with your next chapter
support.summary: LifeTalea is in development. These steps cover the local tools currently implemented.

sections.title: A recording will not start
sections.body: Check microphone permission and free storage. Save the memory before attaching audio. If recognition is unavailable, use the written controls; speech commands and audio recording are separate capabilities.

sections.title: Keep a safe copy
sections.body: Open Settings, choose whether to include photographs and audio, then Create backup. Store the archive somewhere safe. Restore validates the archive and shows a preview before importing.

sections.title: A PDF or archive will not save
sections.body: Try a writable folder with enough free storage. Check that your chosen document provider is available. A failed export should leave source memories intact.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.summary: Contact O.Bankole for LifeTalea support at banksmi@mail.com.

sections.title: Protect your family’s privacy
sections.body: When reporting an issue, describe the device, operating system, app version and steps. Avoid sending private stories, photographs, recordings or backup passphrases.

sections.title: Support availability
sections.body: Write to banksmi@mail.com.
